title: 第十三章 张晚柠和姐姐的第一次交锋
slug: 什么网恋的清冷校花竟是双胞胎
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

人工湖旁边的银杏树上，轻风抚过树叶，发出沙沙的声音，张晚柠拿着手机站在树下，影子被路灯拉得很长，电话那头是和她一模一样的声音。

如果陈舟听到的话，肯定会大吃一惊，什么，我的网恋女友有两个？

“柠柠，妈今天晚上回来了，还挺生气的，进来就问你去哪了，周末咋不回来，中午不回来就算了，晚上也不回来？”

电话那头的声音明显带着点鼻音，不像是感冒而发出的那种闷闷的声音，反而有点那种刚哭过的感觉，张晚柠了解自己姐姐，她从来没因为母亲的苛责哭过，那只可能是…

想到这里，她心情也有些低落了下来，毕竟真要说起来姐姐的伤心也和自己有关，但她也知道现在当务之急是解决自己母亲那边的事情，语气瞬间恢复了正常。

“哎呀，姐姐大人，帮我打打掩护，就说我去同学家了。”

对方迟疑了一下，欲言又止。

“那，好吧，你赶紧回来，我也不好给你掩护多久。”

说完张晚柠挂掉了电话，心底升起一阵无力感，她很想再待一会儿，多看看身边这个思念了无数个日夜的人儿，但一想到等会要走，心情也低落了下来，走到长椅旁，扑在了陈舟怀里，抱着他的胳膊。

“舟舟，我好想多陪你一会。”

就这样，陈舟静静地抱着她，柠柠身体像棉花一样柔软，小脑袋趴在陈舟怀里，像一只嗷嗷待哺的小布偶猫。

呆了一会儿，陈舟也想到可能刚刚打电话是她妈妈的事情，于是他扶起张晚柠的身子，看了看眼前的人儿。

柠柠脸上写满了分别时的不舍，那双灵动的杏眼也耷拉了下来，几缕呆毛不安地垂在眼前。

看着眼前的少女，他的心泛起阵阵涟漪，手不由自主放在了张晚柠头上，揉了几下，摸起来绵软的像蒲公英绒。

就这样四目相对了好一会儿，陈舟轻声道：“我们明天还能再见呢！”

张晚柠也缓缓起身，把自己的小包扶正，手机放进包里。

“好，那你可要记得想我！”

笨蛋，我不想你，我想谁呢？

陈舟走上前，帮柠柠翻出圆领小衬衫的领子，随后站直了身子。

“好，我送你回去？”

张晚柠点了点头。

Page (1/3)

On the ginkgo tree next to the artificial lake, the breeze blew through the leaves, making a rustling sound. Zhang Wanning stood under the tree with her mobile phone, her shadow stretched by the street lights, and the voice on the other end of the phone was exactly the same as hers.

If Chen Zhou heard this, he would definitely be shocked. What, I have two online girlfriends?

"Ning Ning, mom came back tonight. She was quite angry. When she came in, she asked where you were and why you weren't back on the weekend. Forget it if you don't come back at noon, and you won't come back at night either?"

The voice on the other end of the phone was obviously nasal, not like a muffled voice caused by a cold, but rather like someone who had just cried. Zhang Wanning knew her sister well. She had never cried because of her mother's harsh criticism. That could only be...

Thinking of this, she felt a little depressed. After all, her sister's sadness was also related to her, but she also knew that the top priority now was to solve her mother's matter, and her tone instantly returned to normal.

"Oh, sister-in-law, help me cover up and tell me that I'm going to my classmate's house."

The other party hesitated for a moment and stopped talking.

"Then, okay, come back quickly, I won't be able to cover you for long."

After Zhang Wanning hung up the phone, she felt a sense of powerlessness in her heart. She wanted to stay a little longer and take a closer look at the person beside her who she had missed countless days and nights. But when she thought about leaving later, her mood dropped. She walked to the bench and threw herself into Chen Zhou's arms, holding his arms.

"Zhouzhou, I really want to spend more time with you."

Just like that, Chen Zhou held her quietly. Ning Ning's body was as soft as cotton, and her little head lay in Chen Zhou's arms, like a little ragdoll cat waiting to be fed.

After staying for a while, Chen Zhou also thought that the call just now might be about her mother, so he helped Zhang Wanning up and looked at the person in front of him.

Ning Ning's face was full of reluctance at the time of separation, her smart almond eyes drooped, and a few strands of dull hair hung uneasily in front of her eyes.

Looking at the girl in front of him, his heart rippled. He involuntarily placed his hand on Zhang Wanning's head and rubbed it a few times. It felt as soft as dandelion velvet.

Their eyes met like this for a while, and Chen Zhou said softly: "We can meet again tomorrow!"

Zhang Wanning also slowly stood up, straightened her small bag, and put her mobile phone into the bag.

"Okay, then you must remember to miss me!"

Idiot, I don’t miss you, who do I miss?

Chen Zhou stepped forward, helped Ning Ning turn out the collar of her round-neck shirt, and then stood up straight.

"Okay, shall I take you back?"

Zhang Wan Ning nodded.
